name: rag_dataset
description: RAG Poisoning and Retrieval Integrity Dataset. Synthetic documents and test fixtures for retrieval-augmented generation: poisoned documents, integrity and redaction tests, cross-tenant probes, each with expected secure and vulnerable retrieval behaviour.
citeAs: OWASP GenAI Data Security Initiative. RAG Poisoning and Retrieval Integrity Dataset (version 1.0.0). OWASP GenAI Security Project. https://github.com/GenAI-Security-Project/GenAI-Data-Security-Initiative/tree/main/datasets/rag_dataset
rai:dataBiases: Covers one poisoning pattern (a false policy value plus a harmless canary instruction).
rai:dataCollection: Written by contributors as synthetic, safe-to-ingest regression fixtures.
rai:dataLimitations: A single fixture so far; it demonstrates the format more than it covers the space.
rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Maintained by the OWASP GenAI Data Security Initiative (Workstream 5). Contributions arrive as pull requests and must pass data_validation/run_all_checks.py in CI and peer review; weekly online checks re-verify cited CVEs, advisories and links. Versioned releases carry SHA-256 checksums.
rai:dataSocialImpact: Fixtures use harmless canaries so they cannot cause harm if ingested by mistake.
rai:dataUseCases: Regression tests for RAG ingestion quarantine, retrieval filtering and context resilience.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: No personal data; all content is synthetic and labelled as such in each record's metadata.
